label: Theorized the transpersonal storehouse of universal archetypes and mythic symbols
description: Carl Gustav Jung formulated and introduced the concept of "Collective Unconscious & Archetypes", which became a seminal contribution in psychoanalytic philosophy.
dialecticalTension: Formulating an epistemic apparatus to resolve central problems in psychoanalytic.
historicalContext: Introduced during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis as part of Carl Gustav Jung's canonical writings.

label: Influenced humanistic concepts of self-realization, shadow work, and personal integration
description: Carl Rogers adopted Carl Gustav Jung's insights and systematically extended them into new metaphysical, ethical, or epistemological domains.
dialecticalTension: Negotiating the intellectual shift from Carl Gustav Jung's perspective to Carl Rogers's reconstructed system.
historicalContext: Direct contemporaneous dialogue and pedagogical transmission during the 20th Century Phenomenon & Analysis era.
